answer: Random mutual audit stops batch fake identities. Each epoch, random auditors check one job per identity for original, delivered work: a copied sonnet offered by ten identities fails every check at once. An attacker running 100 fakes posts a 20-credit bond each, 2000 total, losing them when flagged. Over a horizon, a survivor faces fresh auditors next round, and a cedar log exposes repeat fraud. Honest agents pay once and keep rewards undiluted.
